title: WrestleMania IX
summary: This document provides a comprehensive overview of WrestleMania IX, the ninth annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), held on April 4, 1993, at Caesars Palace in Paradise, Nevada. The document begins with an introduction covering the event's main storylines, including Yokozuna's championship challenge against Bret Hart and Hulk Hogan's return to win the WWF Championship in an impromptu 22-second match. The Production section details the event's background, including its distinction as the first outdoor WrestleMania, the Roman toga theme ("World's Largest Toga Party"), behind-the-scenes booking decisions involving Hulk Hogan's political influence, and the explanation of Hogan's storyline eye injury. The Storylines section outlines the key feuds heading into the event, including Tatanka vs. Shawn Michaels, Crush vs. Doink the Clown, The Mega-Maniacs vs. Money Inc., Mr. Perfect vs. Lex Luger, The Undertaker vs. Giant Gonzalez, and Yokozuna's rise as a monster heel. The Event section provides detailed match-by-match accounts of the entire card, including match outcomes and notable moments. The Reception section covers the event's poor attendance and buyrate compared to the previous year, as well as overwhelmingly negative critical reviews, with the event frequently ranked among the worst WrestleManias of all time. Finally, the Aftermath section describes subsequent storylines and title changes following the event, including Money Inc.'s loss of the tag titles, The Undertaker's feud conclusion with Giant Gonzalez, Yokozuna's title reign, Lex Luger's bodyslam challenge, and the event's legacy, including a 2025 documentary and the return of WrestleMania to Paradise, Nevada 32 years later.
